[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided an overview of Scrum.org certifications, including Professional Scrum Master (PSM), Professional Scrum Product Owner (PSPO), Professional Scrum Developer (PSD), and Professional Agile Leadership (PAL).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant highlighted key features of Scrum.org certifications, including assessment-based, no training requirement, low cost, no renewal fees, and global recognition.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant compared Scrum.org certifications with Agile Alliance certifications, noting differences in training requirements, costs, renewal fees, and focus.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided details about the PSM assessment, including duration (60 minutes), number of questions (80), passing score (85%), and types of questions (knowledge-based, scenario-based, case study).

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant described the content coverage of the PSM assessment, including Scrum Framework, Scrum Theory, Scrum Roles, Scrum Ceremonies, Scrum Artifacts, and Scrum Implementation.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered tips for preparing for the PSM assessment, including studying the Scrum Framework, practicing with sample questions, reading the Scrum Guide, taking online assessments, and joining a study group.
